title: Best KeePass App for iPhone (2026): KeeForge vs KeePassium, Strongbox and PanicVault
description: KeeForge is the KeePass app for iPhone with every feature free: open source, no subscription, Face ID, passkeys and 2FA AutoFill included. See how it compares with KeePassium, Strongbox and PanicVault. Checked 24 November 2026.
eyebrow: Best KeePass app for iPhone · Checked 24 November 2026
heading: Our pick: KeeForge.
lead: The KeePass app for iPhone, iPad and Mac with nothing locked behind a paywall.
strengths: Every feature free. No subscription, no paid tier, no database limit.
Passkeys, 2FA codes and passwords in AutoFill, with Face ID.
Open source under GPLv3. No account, no tracking.
One app for iPhone, iPad and a native Mac app.

verdict.label: Face ID unlock at no cost
Dropbox & OneDrive built in
verdict.keeforge: Plus WebDAV, FTP and iCloud Drive

fullTableTitle: All five apps, side by side

rows.label: Price on iPhone
cells: Free for one database. Premium €19.99/year (rent-to-own) or Pro €79.99 once.
Free for non-commercial use. Pro $2.99/month, $24.99/year or $124.99 lifetime (website prices).
$4.99 once (US App Store). No free version.

rows.label: Paid features
cells: More than one database, YubiKey, Quick AutoFill, password audit, linked databases, business cloud accounts.
On iPhone: Face ID / Touch ID unlock, offline editing, YubiKey, Apple Watch. On Mac, AutoFill, passkeys, SFTP and WebDAV are also Pro.

rows.label: Source code
cells: Published under AGPL-3.0, but the project calls itself "source available": no build path, and code drops lag releases.

rows.label: Apple platforms
cells: iPhone, iPad, Mac (Mac Catalyst), Vision Pro.
iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Watch, Vision Pro.
iPhone, iPad. Desktop apps for Mac, Windows and Linux, plus Android.

rows.label: Database formats
cells: KDBX 4 read and write. KDBX 3.1 read-only.
KDBX 4.1, 4.0 and 3.1, KeePass 1 (.kdb), and Password Safe 3.
KDBX 4 only. Older files must be upgraded first.

rows.label: Passkeys
cells: Yes (free on iPhone, Pro on Mac).
Stores KeePassXC-format passkeys. iPhone passkey AutoFill not documented.

rows.label: 2FA (TOTP) codes
cells: Yes, including AutoFill on iOS 18 and Mac.
Yes, in the app. The Mac browser extension fills them.

rows.label: Built-in sync
cells: iPhone and iPad: Dropbox, OneDrive, WebDAV, FTP, plus iCloud Drive and other Files providers. Mac: WebDAV, FTP and synced folders.
Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, WebDAV, plus iCloud Drive and other Files providers.
iCloud, Dropbox, OneDrive, Google Drive, WebDAV, SFTP, plus Files providers. SharePoint is Pro.

rows.label: YubiKey
cells: Paid. Lightning, NFC on iPhone, USB on Mac.
Pro. USB-C keys not supported on iOS.
NFC on iPhone, USB on Mac. Not on iPad.

rows.label: Independent security audit
cells: No code-level audit, per Strongbox. Yearly CASA Tier 2 assessment.

keepassxcBody: KeePassXC has no iPhone app; its FAQ suggests Strongbox and KeePassium. KeeForge opens KeePassXC’s KDBX 4 databases and reads its passkeys. Put the file in iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive or on a WebDAV server and add it in KeeForge.
sourcesNote: Opened and checked on 24 November 2026. App versions and dates are from the US App Store.
